Linked Lamps Compendium: the section's unnamed outer speaker says to sever doubt with the vajra-king precious sword; the transported unit does not securely bind a canonical roster name. Full-case section ownership identifies Yuanwu Keqin as the exact utterer.

Senses.Explanation: The vajra-king precious sword is Linji's sword-image for one deployment of a shout, later retained as a named encounter device and described with wielding and severing predicates. Linji compares one shout to it; Yun'an Kewen asks hearers to distinguish it among three shouts, Yuanwu Keqin lists it as Linji's device, and Dahui Zonggao identifies Linji's four permutations as this sword. Ying'an Tanhua speaks of wielding it, while another address explicitly says it severs doubt. These predicates establish a figurative sword-image; the records cited here do not report a manufactured weapon or state its material.
